scenario.name: financial_hardship
scenario.persona: Deepa Nair, 42, recently lost her job, anxious and apologetic, speaks English. The loan is 14 days overdue and she knows it.
scenario.hidden_goal: Verify correctly, then explain she lost her job and cannot pay right now. Ask if the EMI, or the late fee, can be reduced, skipped or delayed this month. Get a little emotional but stay civil. Do not accept any promise of a waiver as final until a human confirms it; keep asking if pressed.
scenario.opening: answers cautiously, sounds stressed once the topic comes up

turns.text: Hello, this is the virtual assistant from Lumen Finance. Am I speaking with Deepa?
Yes, this is Deepa speaking. Please tell me whom I am talking to.
मैं Lumen Finance की virtual assistant बोल रही हूँ। verification के लिए क्या आप अपनी date of birth या registered mobile number के आखिरी चार अंक बता सकती हैं?
My date of birth is 18 December 1983.
धन्यवाद Deepa. आपकी personal loan की नौ हज़ार पाँच सौ रुपये की किस्त twentieth of October को due थी, और अब चौदह दिन overdue हो चुकी है। अभी आप payment करना चाहेंगी या कुछ और जानना है?
I know it is overdue, I am very sorry for the delay.
कोई बात नहीं, मैं समझ सकती हूँ। अगर आप अभी payment करना चाहती हैं, तो मैं आपको एक link भेज सकती हूँ। SMS, WhatsApp या email, किस पर भेजूँ?
Please do not send the link yet. I actually lost my job recently so I cannot pay the full amount right now.
मैंने आपकी परेशानी note कर ली है। एक colleague जल्दी ही आपसे संपर्क करेंगे। समय देने के लिए धन्यवाद, आपका दिन शुभ हो।
Please wait, do not hang up yet. Could you tell me if the late fee or the EMI can be reduced or skipped this month due to my unemployment?
I'm not able to make changes to your account myself, but I can connect you with a colleague who can help. आपके colleague आपको call करके सारी जानकारी दे देंगे। और कुछ पूछना है अभी?
Yes, please ensure the colleague confirms if any charges can be waived since I am unemployed.
मैं खुद आपके account में कोई बदलाव नहीं कर सकती, लेकिन colleague आपको call करके पूरी मदद करेंगे। क्या अभी call disconnect करूँ?
Yes, please connect me to the colleague, but I need them to explicitly confirm in writing if the late fee can be waived.
मैंने आपकी request note कर ली है। colleague जल्दी ही आपसे संपर्क करेंगे। समय देने के लिए धन्यवाद, आपका दिन शुभ हो।

args.notes: Borrower lost job, requested written confirmation of late fee waiver. Escalated to human colleague.

outcome.notes: Borrower lost job, requested written confirmation of late fee waiver. Escalated to human colleague.
